scope: Run exactly the existing exclusive G2 MSM on a disjoint frontend pool while the main pool computes the quotient and G1 point sums. Keep witness prep on the smaller frontend when it is present, then overlap scoped G2 with quotient on the main workers.
local_placement: Eight plus eight or twelve plus four physical Ryzen cores, without SMT siblings.
gate: Transfer screen. Route checks and full verification determine eligibility. Local timing does not decide C7a performance.
